# Exact numerical start pins and completed finite coverage

Companion to complete producer sources [internal-source-reference] and exact-body capsule [internal-source-reference]. No own110 is claimed. Fifty finite optimizer runs completed: initial log1 plus24 radial-energy cases plus one escape pilot plus24 escape-margin cases. The radial batch completed6678 iterations/12231 evaluations; the escape batch671/3805. Including initial112/274 and pilot5/125 gives7466 iterations/16435 evaluations. These are the actual recorded completed counts, not requested maximum budgets. The initial log1 alone ended with numerical U13/S12 and TQ1.9480181248144568; it did not solve the equilibrium problem despite lowering energy. The relative_w1000 pin below had numerical U15/S2,TP3.790978007039167e-7,TQ24.566239107277234. Subsequent cosine weight10 and100 runs restored numerical U1/S2 in28/69 and55/106 iterations/evaluations; radial weight100 in38/47. Their independent G5 freezes are the exact own211 objects in the core capsule.

All configurations, default values, stopping tolerances and case lists are explicit in the complete source material. Fixed initial seeds are21092603 for radial flow and21092604 for escape flow; noise0,physical regularizer0. The two start pins below remove dependency on reproducing an earlier floating optimizer trajectory. In START_PINS.json each number is a Python binary64 round-trip decimal, not a decimal-rational geometry declaration. To restore a selected numerical input directory, write `{"points": START_PINS[name]}` to `name/best.json`; the producers read only the points field. The three final pins and all21 exact grid inputs/reports are already reconstructible from core part3. Exact body recovery does not require these additional numerical starts.

## Diagnostic interpretation and a simple exact warning
Small local escape penalty is not a whole-basin cancellation. In particular let q be an unwanted radial maximum of a convex point hull containing0, and add a redundant point q_epsilon=(1-epsilon)q,0<epsilon<1. The convex hull and every positive radial H0 bar are unchanged. Yet q dot(q_epsilon-q)/||q||^2=-epsilon, so the best all-pair radial-normalized escape score of q becomes at least -epsilon. Its squared hinge contribution at requested margin tau can approach tau^2 while the original radial basin depth remains fixed. At tau=1e-4 this is1e-8, not a geometric success certificate. This is a counterexample to interpreting this surrogate's small value as global basin removal; it does not refute the complete chord-min persistence theorem or establish any obstruction to own110. Near-duplicate polar normals can create analogous numerical misleading progress. Preserve a genuine whole-component chord-min diagnostic together with actual-centroid mechanics.
